title: Buffer Review (2026)
intro: Buffer is evaluated here as Marketing & Growth software — Buffer is a social media management platform for scheduling, analytics, engagement, and AI-assisted content. Pricing: Free (up to 3 channels, 10 scheduled posts/channel), Essentials from $6/mo per channel, Team from $12/mo per channel, with volume discounts as channels grow; 14-day trial on paid plans. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s marketing methodology (ease of use, campaign/content tools, marketing automation, funnel/conversion, analytics, brand monitoring, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Buffer when simple, affordable social scheduling with mainstream brand recognition is the primary marketing job.
verdict: Choose Buffer when simple, affordable social scheduling with mainstream brand recognition is the primary marketing job. Compare SocialBee for content recycling depth, Brand24 for listening, Kartra/ClickFunnels for funnels, and Marketo for enterprise MAP. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.
